snippets.title: My remote is not working

agentUtterance.text:
If your Bell Satellite TV remote is not controlling your receiver, please try the following steps:

1. Replace the batteries in your remote.
2. Press "SYSTEM INFO" on the front panel of the receiver.
3. On your Bell Satellite TV remote, press the "rec" (record) button.

After pressing "rec", the number on the Remote Address ID should change from 01 to your remote's address. You should then be able to control the receiver.
